div.div: عَتِيدٌ A thing (S, O, L) ready, at hand, or prepared; (S, A, O, L, K;) as also ↓ عَتَدٌ [q. v.]: pl. [of pauc.] of the latter أَعْتَادٌ and [of mult.] عُتُدٌ: (Msb:) the former occurs in the Kur l. 22, (O, L,) in this sense: or as meaning near: (L:) or as meaning ↓ مُعْتَدٌ , (O,) i. e. made ready, or prepared. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
